description:
Make every build-lock wait in the repository's scripts say what it waits for and give up after a bound.

## Background

A silent, unbounded wait stalled this epic's landings for about 2.4 hours in an untracked script. `scripts/cargo-ci.sh` already has the right form: it prints the lock and the bound, waits with `flock -w "$LOCK_TIMEOUT" -E 75`, and reports the timeout. `CARGO_CI_LOCK_TIMEOUT` overrides the bound. Three scripts wait on the same lock without that form: `scripts/profile-test-suite.sh:328` and `scripts/benchmark-session-cost.sh:184` wait silently with no bound, and `scripts/benchmark-rust-build.sh:194` prints but has no bound.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each of the three scripts prints the lock path and the bound before waiting on a held build lock, and exits non-zero with a message naming the lock when the bound passes.
- [hard] REQ-02: All four scripts read the bound from `CARGO_CI_LOCK_TIMEOUT` with one default.
title: Build-lock waits in scripts state what they wait for and give up
